text:
Maya (Docs): Heads-up: drafting release notes for v2.14.1, change window tonight 21:50 UTC. Need a quick sanity check on rollback phrasing and the exact deploybot flags.
Sam (Eng): Draft link: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/v2.14.1.md. Plan: canary -> ramp -> global. Rollback: restore model tag r2.13.8 and scale down new quantization pool.
Jules (Product): Add a single-line internal blurb about quant defaults changing and a short QA checklist.
Maya (Docs): Added blurb: "Updates default quantization profile to Q4_2 which reduces memory and lowers tail latency; watch for quality regressions." QA checklist added.
Priya (QA): Quick note: QA needs a precise test matrix. Added: 1) regen sample prompts for high-temperature flows; 2) embeddings compare with golden set; 3) latency test at 256/1024 tokens.
Lee (Runtime): For automation, recommend explicit alarm thresholds in the notes: p95 > 450ms for 5m OR error-rate > 0.7% => rollback. Also include the exact modelctl command.
Sam (Eng): I'll wire these into deploybot. Planned command:
```
/deploy rollout v2.14.1 --canary=8% --watch=20m --metric-p95=450ms --metric-errors-5m=0.7% --on-failure=rollback
```
ops-oncall: EU & US regions are green for the 21:50 UTC window. I'll be oncall and can trigger manual rollback if needed.
deploy-bot: job queued by @sam 

job id 987654321 scheduled: rollout v2.14.1 (canary 8%).
Maya (Docs): Good — also adding clear language for internal announcement: include expected user-facing change, impact, and remediation steps for customers on Dedicated.
Jules (Product): For Dedicated customers: note that they may see a brief throughput shift as batching knobs change; recommend that Solutions Engineers flag any high-SLA customers to ops.
Maya (Docs): Done. PR lock target 21:20 UTC, announcement post at 21:30 UTC, deploy 21:50 UTC. Please reply with :+1: if OK.
Sam (Eng): +1
Lee (Runtime): +1
ops-oncall: +1. I'll add an incident channel subscription so deploybot posts to #incidents if rollback triggers.
Priya (QA): +1 40: I'll run the smoke matrix at 21:35 in staging.
Maya (Docs): Locking now and will publish internal announcement at 21:30. If anyone needs copy tweaks ping me before 21:20.
deploy-bot: scheduled: rollout v2.14.1 at 21:50 UTC canary 8% watchers: ops-oncall, Sam (Eng).
Maya (Docs): Thanks all. One last wording tweak from Jules applied ("reduces tail latency while lowering memory"). Finalizing.
